exact_analytic_declarations.name: RH_HilbertLimit.canonical_actual_root_limit_exists
exact_analytic_declarations.type: ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ Tendsto (rootScale actualVariation) atTop (𝓝 R)

exact_analytic_declarations.name: RH_HilbertLimit.canonical_actual_weights_nonnegative_iff_nativeRH
exact_analytic_declarations.type: (∀ N j, j ≤ N → 0 ≤ actualWeight N j) ↔ _root_.RiemannHypothesis

exact_analytic_declarations.name: RH_HilbertLimit.canonical_actual_natural_bound_iff_nativeRH_constructed
exact_analytic_declarations.type: (∃ B : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, actualVariation n ≤ (B : ℝ)) ↔ _root_.RiemannHypothesis

root_scale_definition: rootScale (V : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := Real.rpow (V n) ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)
natural_growth_step_definition: NaturalGrowthStep (V : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (V (n + 1) - V n) ≤ (K : ℝ) * V n
analytic_endpoint_interpretation: The constructed root-scale sequence has an ordinary limit equal to spectralRadius canonicalNode, with an existential limit value R ≥ 1.

A limit value of one, subexponential variation, all variation values equal to one, nonnegative weights, an existential natural growth step, and an existential natural uniform bound are each stated equivalent to the actual _root_.RiemannHypothesis.
These constructed endpoint declarations have no extra analytic input hypotheses in their signatures.
The root-scale limit declaration alone does not establish that its value is one, convergence of unrooted actualVariation, actual subexponential growth, or RH.

finite_checker_boundary.distinction: A finite natural number B or K with a universally quantified all-order admissibility property does not supply a terminating Boolean check. The analytic equivalences do not close the separate raw finite-checker equivalence.
